text.p: Typhoon Zane is a major risk to shipping and to the islands in the southern East China Sea. The Ryukyu islands from just east of Taiwan to Okinawa are at risk this weekend. Heavy rains and flooding may lead to damage. Strong winds and strong seas may lead to additional damage. Shipping is at risk due to rough seas and strong winds. The system is expected to pass east of Taiwan this weekend but it still bear watching as it may have some impact on this island if an expected turn to the north is slow to occur.

Typhoon Yates, centered about 530 miles northwest of Guam, is moving north northwest at 10 mph. Top winds are near 130 mph. A slow weakening trend will begin this period as the storm turns to the north then northeast this weekend. This system is a strong risk to shipping this period. The islands of Iwo Jima, the Volcano islands and the Bonin islands are also at risk.

Hurricane Isidore, centered about 1000 miles west of the Cape Verde Islands, is moving west northwest at 15 mph. A gradual turn to the northwest is expected, keeping the storm over open waters. There is no threat to land at this time. Isidore is a threat to shipping.
